name: Every bundled tariff draws a distinct price curve

planSteps.description: Open the app and wait for the initial solve to finish.
Note the shape of the price ribbon: which hours are the cheap teal trough and which are crimson.
Switch the tariff selector from 'Overnight EV' to 'Evening peak' and wait for the ribbon to redraw.
Verify the ribbon redraws as a different curve, with the trough and peak at different hours than 'Overnight EV'.
Switch to 'Four-season peak', then to 'Flat rate', waiting for each redraw.
Verify each tariff produces its own curve, and that 'Flat rate' renders a single uniform band because its price never changes.
